{{Quote|Attention, emergency evac fleet. You've come from all over the galaxy, willing to risk your ships and yourselves in order to save the lives of others. Now is your moment.|Gar Stazi|<ref name="Legacy 47" />}}
The '''emergency evac fleet''' was an ad hoc [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] assembled in the final days of [[137 ABY]] in order to assist the [[Galactic Alliance Remnant]] in [[Evacuation of Dac|evacuating]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dac/Legends|Dac]] following its [[Final Protocol|poisoning]] by the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Vul Isen]]. When word of Isen's actions spread across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], volunteers flocked to Stazi's banner in order to save the lives of the [[Water/Legends|water]] world's residents.<ref name="Legacy 47" />

The volunteers were fired upon by a [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Sith–Imperial]] fleet during the evacuation, but Alliance [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gar Stazi]] ordered the [[Core Fleet|Galactic Alliance Core Fleet]] to position themselves between the evac fleet and the Imperial forces. The arrival of the Alliance's allies, the [[Empire-in-exile]], forced the Sith&ndash;Imperials to flee and allowed the evacuation to continue.<ref name="Legacy 47" />

==Strength==
The evacuation fleet consisted of a multitude of different [[Starship/Legends|starships]], including one [[Ardent-class fast frigate]], several [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvettes]], an [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]], a [[G9 Rigger-class light freighter/Legends|G9 ''Rigger''-class light freighter]], some [[GR-75 medium transport/Legends|GR-75 medium transports]], one [[Immobilizer 418 Interdictor-class Heavy Cruiser|Immobilizer 418 cruiser]], an [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]], several [[MC80 Liberty Type Heavy Star Cruiser/Legends|MC80 Liberty type Star Cruisers]], a [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]], one [[YX-1980 space transport]]&mdash;the ''[[Grinning Liar]]''&mdash;and some [[YZ 3000 tanker]]s.<ref name="Legacy 47" />
